title: Vela — the customer agent
description: Vela is a customer agent that resolves support, sales and commerce conversations end to end.

header.announceDesktop: Beacon lands Nov 12: a day on what AI is doing to customer teams.

hero.heading: Every customer, answered like your best day

items.heading: Vela resolves more conversations than any other customer agent
body: Vela's resolution rate averages 74% across 9,000+ teams, and many of them see well over 80%.
Vela improves with every week it spends on the job. It now closes 1.6 million conversations a week, and its average resolution rate climbs every month.

aside.label: [ 01.A ]
aside.caption: Why an AI research lab picked Vela instead of building.

chart.ariaLabel: Resolution rate rising from 34% to 78% over three years

items.heading: Vela is trusted by thousands of forward-looking teams
body: Our customers span software, retail, fintech and travel, from ten-person startups to global support orgs.

items.heading: Vela outperforms because the models underneath are ours
body: Vela runs on Meridian and Meridian Flash, models trained on billions of real support interactions.
They are tuned for one job, customer conversations, which makes them faster, cheaper and more accurate at it.

items.heading: One agent for the whole customer journey
body: One customer-facing agent that carries context from the first question to the tenth renewal.
Service, sales or commerce: switch a role on and Vela already knows the moves.

aside.label: [ 04.A ]
aside.caption: See one conversation move from support to checkout.

cards.title: Vela for Service
cards.body: Delivers resolutions, not deflections, on every support queue.

cards.title: Vela for Sales
cards.body: Qualifies, answers and books inbound leads end to end.

cards.title: Vela for Commerce
cards.body: Guides the whole shopping journey, cart to return label.

items.heading: Vela ships improvements weekly
body: We ship at a pace that compounds: 218 product updates last year, 174 already this year.

items.heading: Vela resolves the hard cases, not just the FAQs
body: Vela reads and writes to complicated third-party systems: it changes account records, moves refunds and files the paperwork.
Multi-step, policy-heavy, edge-case work is exactly where it pulls ahead.

aside.label: [ 06.A ]
aside.caption: Watch a five-system refund resolved in one thread.

items.heading: Vela speaks to every system you already run
body: Over MCP, connectors or plain API, Vela pulls in customer data and takes real actions.
Extend it with custom actions and workflows through a fully open platform.

items.pre: “Vela reads order status and delivery windows straight out of our commerce stack, so
items.post: to learn where their package is.”
items.name: Maren Oduya

items.heading: Vela is at home on every channel your customers use
body: Voice, chat, email, messaging and social are all native, so the conversation happens wherever it starts.
Voice runs on Meridian Flash, a model built for low-latency conversation.

aside.label: [ 08.A ]
aside.caption: Hear Vela take a voice call.

items.heading: Bring your own helpdesk, Vela fits right in
body: Escalations land with a human carrying the whole story, whichever helpdesk you run, and setup needs no migration project.

items.heading: Confidence comes standard: you hold the controls
body: Configure tone, behavior, knowledge and guardrails yourself, without an engineering ticket.

items.heading: Trust, safety and reliability are the foundation, not features
body: Designed to stay up, redundant at every layer, and built by a team that has run some of the most security-conscious systems in the industry.

items.heading: Every conversation leaves Vela a little sharper
body: Every conversation feeds a flywheel: Vela works, learns, and turns what it learned into recommendations you can accept in one click.

items.pre: “Other vendors demoed beautifully, then wanted an engineering ticket for every tweak.
items.marked: Vela hands the dials to my team
items.name: Ines Kovar

items.heading: Vela studies your business until it thinks like you
body: Vela learns your goals, policies, rules and procedures, and that understanding lets it reason through multi-step problems the way your best agent would.

aside.label: [ 13.A ]
aside.caption: How teams encode policy into Vela in an afternoon.

items.heading: Every change is tested against yesterday’s conversations first
body: Run simulations, regression tests and manual inspections against real historical conversations before anything goes live.
items.label: Simulation run · 2,400 conversations

items.heading: See everything Vela does, and why it did it
body: Measure everything happening across your customer operations, with AI-powered insights, QA and alerts on what you care about most.

items.heading: Vela Conductor keeps the operation humming without you
body: Vela Conductor orchestrates the backstage work: it spots problems, finds improvements, and does the routine upkeep humans used to queue for.

aside.label: [ 16.A ]
aside.caption: Conductor triages a backlog spike, unattended.

cards.label: Detected
cards.body: Spike in delivery questions from one carrier region. Suggested macro drafted.

cards.label: Automated
cards.body: Nightly knowledge sync from your docs, with diffs held for approval.

items.heading: Vela comes with a step-by-step playbook for AI transformation
body: We ran the transformation on ourselves before asking anyone else to, then repeated it with thousands of teams. Everything we learned is encoded in one practical guide.

items.heading: Results come from partnership, and we go deep
body: Deployment engineers sit with your team and tune Vela to your bespoke requirements. We treat customers as partners in the product.

items.heading: We publish our research, openly and early
body: What we learn goes public so the field moves faster: papers, benchmarks and reports the industry actually cites.

cards.title: How we built a production reranker

items.heading: Vela events deliver world-class teaching, big and small
body: Everyone is trying to figure out this era at once, so we get in rooms with our customers and work it out together.

items.heading: Vela invented outcome-based pricing for customer agents
body: You only pay when Vela actually resolves something. Alerts, caps and live reporting keep the spend in your hands.
As Vela shoulders more of the queue, the cost of support falls, and the savings fund more strategic work.

items.heading: Vela has the clearest vision for what comes next
body: Three years ago we shipped the first customer agent and created the category. The next leap is making perfect customer experiences the default, for everyone.
